A[Instrumental Intro]
[Slow ambient texture, vintage analog organ pads, 60 bpm]
[Sparse minimalist bass notes]

[Instrumental Verse]
[Subtle halftime drums enter, steady dark atmosphere]
[Sustained melancholic keyboard chords building tension]

[Spoken word over slow ambient]
El tiempo se estira en la ruta gris...
sombras largas bajo el metal.

[Multi-voice harmony enters]
[Tempo shift to steady marching beat]
Un pulso antiguo que vuelve a latir,
un destello ciego en la oscuridad.
[Acoustic guitar fingerpicking enters]
[Atmospheric choir swell]
[Sustained organ pads]
Nadie responde, el viento es igual...
solo el compás que empieza a girar.
[Acoustic guitar fingerpicking enters]
[Choral outro fading]
[Halftime transition, slow crawl]

[Tempo shift to steady marching beat]
[Heavy rhythmic bassline joins]
[Driving electric guitar sustain with massive reverb]
[Mid-tempo rhythmic transition]

[Instrumental Bridge]
[Sudden drop in volume, minimal eerie organ solo]
[Drums fade out, sparse percussion only]

[Halftime transition, slow crawl]
[Atmospheric synth pads returning]
[Deep melancholic organ chords]

[Instrumental Outro]
[Gradual fade to absolute silence]
[Final isolated organ note echoing]
